title: Head Swap sends a box that is not the one drawn - the whole image reaches the sampler
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 (the Flow track). Raised by Fabio 2026-09-18 while proving MPI-532; NOT package-specific.

SYMPTOM: in the Head Swap flow the latent entering the sampler is the WHOLE target image (three people), not the head crop the user boxed. The same graph on the G:\ComfyUi bench, with a hand-set Input_Box, crops to the face correctly - so the graph works and the BOX the app sends is wrong.

MEASURED (project "New Project", 2026-09-18):
- user:head-swap-test 14:21 - box1 {x:-619, y:556, w:1299, h:1299}, box2 {x:-183, y:185, w:1176, h:1176}; inputs 1664x2304 (image1) and 768x1344 (image2).
- flowHeadSwap (the BUILT-IN op) 11:21 - box1 {x:-245, y:594, w:1166, h:1166}, box2 {x:-201, y:173, w:1171, h:1171}. Same shape, so this is Head Swap itself, not the package loader.
- Both runs: x is NEGATIVE (the box starts outside the image) and the box is most of the image, not a head.
- The app UI showed "1290 x 1290" under the target gizmo and "1171 x 1171" under the reference one, while the sidecar recorded 1299 and 1176 - close but not equal, so size and origin come from different places.
- The dispatched graph (:48188/history job d89361c6) carries exactly the sidecar numbers, so the injector is faithful: the wrong values are produced BEFORE injection, in the gizmo/param capture.

FIRST SUSPECTS (hypotheses, not conclusions): the box gizmo maps its rect against the canvas/frame rather than the image, so the image offset inside a letterboxed canvas is never subtracted (a negative x is exactly that shape); or a default/stale rect is sent instead of the drawn one. MPI-771 changed the frame strip press handling on 2026-09-17 - check whether this predates it (the user has run Head Swap successfully before).

START AT: the box step kind (js/utils/stepKinds.js / MpiBaseFlow step gizmos), the step `param` bind that writes box1/box2 into injectionParams, and headSwapInjector.js (BOX_TITLES box1/box2). Reproduce by boxing a head and reading the sidecar - no GPU needed to see the wrong numbers.

ALSO: Fabio re-exported comfy_workflows/raw/flow_head_swap.json on 2026-09-18 (RemoveBackground now runs AFTER the reference area is picked up). Uncommitted, and the runtime graph still needs the raw->API sync; he says the change does not affect this bug.
